        <section class="content article-content mb-6" itemprop="articleBody">
          <p>You can use <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/36354416686477" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Optimizely Opal</a> to generate text for a task based on a prompt<em> </em>describing the text you want. Integrating AI-driven content into Optimizely Content Marketing Platform (CMP) enhances productivity and streamlines the content creation process. AI offers a competitive edge in the market by giving you a valuable tool for creating content.</p><p>Key features</p><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="ef3b9a7a6e55c72f278ba0358183a5396">Generate different types of text content, such as blog posts, article titles, or outlines for articles.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb6fe45bd2eb48c5aad02bf59a07c0e20">Input a topic and set your content's tone, sentiment, and word count limit.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e57d1ddd974be042bc86dc244de8514f5">Regenerate content until you get the desired results.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e2e389ccc67ec238100b11cc3e6d32e85">Add the generated content directly to the editor with just a click.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ec7718a5ed7d4fe07e249f18305ea6ef9">Access the AI Text Generator from the content tab and the editor.</li>
</ul><p>Before getting started, <a href="/hc/en-us/articles/44743496216973" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Configure CMP for Optimizely Opal</a>.</p><p>To generate text from a task, open the <strong>Content</strong> tab, click <strong>Add Content</strong>, then select <strong>Generate ></strong> <strong>Text</strong>. </p><figure class="wysiwyg-image"><img style="aspect-ratio: 1007/668;" src="/hc/article_attachments/14825327687309" alt="Generate-AI-text-1.png" width="1007" height="668" class="img-enlargable"></figure><p>The <strong>Generate Text </strong>window displays.</p><figure class="wysiwyg-image"><img style="aspect-ratio: 874/632;" src="/hc/article_attachments/14825336605197" alt="Generate-AI-text-2.png" width="874" height="632" class="img-enlargable"></figure><ul>
<li data-list-item-id="eb2c9ba33e5af23e829d15aa1e3535ce6">
<strong>Blog Post</strong>, <strong>Title</strong>, <strong>Outline</strong> – Select the type of content you want the AI to generate.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ee7c421e3dce6ceee310d162a188c3131">
<strong>About</strong> – Describe the text you want the AI to generate, such as <em>How does AI generate text?</em>
</li>
<li data-list-item-id="ef8a94313449ec40aec4fd322334f98e3">
<strong>Sentiment</strong> – Select a <strong>Neutral</strong>, <strong>Positive</strong>, or <strong>Negative</strong> sentiment to add bias to the content.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="e1ca520a9532a9fadd5f44b9662b8041c">
<strong>Tone</strong> – Select <strong>Formal</strong> or <strong>Informal</strong> writing tone.</li>
<li data-list-item-id="eb9ea67c4ac91c4d06fc9218dfd6dd970">
<strong>Work Limit</strong> – You can specify up to 1000 words for <strong>Blog Post</strong>. For <strong>Outline</strong>, you can specify up to 75 words. <strong>Word Limit</strong> does not display for <strong>Title</strong>.</li>
</ul><h2 id="h_01HNDKPQAFP7M9NNJYGDT51NMJ">Generate blog posts<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01HNDKPQAFP7M9NNJYGDT51NMJ"></a></h2><p>Enter a prompt in the <strong>About </strong>text box that describes the text you want the AI to generate, such as <em>How does AI generate text? </em>Click <strong>Next</strong>. The following examples show AI-produced content based on the settings you select.</p><h3 id="h_01HNDKPQAFPKDWNX5CSM5EEE4E">Blog Post with positive sentiment, formal tone, and word limit<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01HNDKPQAFPKDWNX5CSM5EEE4E"></a></h3><p>One result is: <em>How does AI generate text? </em></p><figure class="wysiwyg-image"><img style="aspect-ratio: 876/369;" src="/hc/article_attachments/14825336791949" alt="Generate-AI-text-3.png" width="876" height="369" class="img-enlargable"></figure><p>You can click <strong>Re-Generate</strong> to change the text with a click, as shown in the following image.</p><figure class="wysiwyg-image"><img style="aspect-ratio: 866/155;" src="/hc/article_attachments/14841840103821" alt="Generate-AI-text-4-a.png" width="866" height="155" class="img-enlargable"></figure><p>Click <strong>Add to Editor</strong> to place the text in the Content editor.</p><figure class="wysiwyg-image"><img style="aspect-ratio: 995/572;" src="/hc/article_attachments/14825527203853" alt="Generate-AI-text-5.png" width="995" height="572" class="img-enlargable"></figure><h2 id="h_01HNDKPQAF5VTJ5A4YJATZPPET">Generate titles<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01HNDKPQAF5VTJ5A4YJATZPPET"></a></h2><h3 id="h_01HNDKPQAFHSG2AZB823F2HSTW">Title with positive sentiment and formal tone<a class="link-anchor" href="#h_01HNDKPQAFHSG2AZB823F2HSTW"></a></h3><p>Contrast the positive and negative sentiment results in the next section.</p><figure class="wysiwyg-image"><img style="aspect-ratio: 870/563;" src="/hc/article_attachments/14825326954509" alt="Generate-AI-text-Title-positive-Formal-results.png" width="870" height="563" class="img-enlargable"></figure><p>You can click <strong>Re-Generate</strong> to change the text with a click. BodyMarkdown:
Generate AI content – Support Help Center                   

[Skip to main content](#page-container)

You can use [Optimizely Opal](/hc/en-us/articles/36354416686477) to generate text for a task based on a prompt describing the text you want. Integrating AI-driven content into Optimizely Content Marketing Platform (CMP) enhances productivity and streamlines the content creation process. AI offers a competitive edge in the market by giving you a valuable tool for creating content.

Key features

*   Generate different types of text content, such as blog posts, article titles, or outlines for articles.
*   Input a topic and set your content's tone, sentiment, and word count limit.
*   Regenerate content until you get the desired results.
*   Add the generated content directly to the editor with just a click.
*   Access the AI Text Generator from the content tab and the editor.

Before getting started, [Configure CMP for Optimizely Opal](/hc/en-us/articles/44743496216973).

To generate text from a task, open the **Content** tab, click **Add Content**, then select **Generate >** **Text**. 

![Generate-AI-text-1.png](/hc/article_attachments/14825327687309)

The **Generate Text** window displays.

![Generate-AI-text-2.png](/hc/article_attachments/14825336605197)

*   **Blog Post**, **Title**, **Outline** – Select the type of content you want the AI to generate.
*   **About** – Describe the text you want the AI to generate, such as _How does AI generate text?_
*   **Sentiment** – Select a **Neutral**, **Positive**, or **Negative** sentiment to add bias to the content.
*   **Tone** – Select **Formal** or **Informal** writing tone.
*   **Work Limit** – You can specify up to 1000 words for **Blog Post**. For **Outline**, you can specify up to 75 words. **Word Limit** does not display for **Title**.

## Generate blog posts[](#h_01HNDKPQAFP7M9NNJYGDT51NMJ)

Enter a prompt in the **About** text box that describes the text you want the AI to generate, such as _How does AI generate text?_ Click **Next**. The following examples show AI-produced content based on the settings you select.

### Blog Post with positive sentiment, formal tone, and word limit[](#h_01HNDKPQAFPKDWNX5CSM5EEE4E)

One result is: _How does AI generate text?_ 

![Generate-AI-text-3.png](/hc/article_attachments/14825336791949)

You can click **Re-Generate** to change the text with a click, as shown in the following image.

![Generate-AI-text-4-a.png](/hc/article_attachments/14841840103821)

Click **Add to Editor** to place the text in the Content editor.

![Generate-AI-text-5.png](/hc/article_attachments/14825527203853)

## Generate titles[](#h_01HNDKPQAF5VTJ5A4YJATZPPET)

### Title with positive sentiment and formal tone[](#h_01HNDKPQAFHSG2AZB823F2HSTW)

Contrast the positive and negative sentiment results in the next section.

![Generate-AI-text-Title-positive-Formal-results.png](/hc/article_attachments/14825326954509)

You can click **Re-Generate** to change the text with a click. You can select one and click **Add to Editor**. 

![Generate-AI-text-text-select-result.png](/hc/article_attachments/14826104469773)

### Title with negative sentiment and formal tone[](#h_01HNDKPQAFEFPNBFYTMBTDC2JK)

Contrast the negative and positive sentiment results in the previous section.

![Generate-AI-text-Title-Negative-Formal-results.png](/hc/article_attachments/14825327107085)

## Generate outlines[](#h_01HNDKPQAF514767GX59M6N9F5)

### Outline with neutral sentiment and word limit[](#h_01HNDKPQAFNS1SACSSAWA8728E)

![Generate-AI-text-outline-neutral-1.png](/hc/article_attachments/14825327310349)

The following image shows two of the five results. You can click **Re-Generate** to get even more options.

![Generate-AI-text-outline-neutral-2.png](/hc/article_attachments/14825327324429)

Select the checkbox for one or more options and click **Add to Editor**. You can also indicate which options you like or dislike by clicking the thumbs-up or thumbs-down icons, which add weight to future results.

![Generate-AI-text-outline-select-result.png](/hc/article_attachments/14825845776653)

Each time you click **Add to Editor**, you add another piece of content to the task. The following image shows three AI-generated pieces of content: blog post, title, and outline, giving you a head start at creating content.

![Generate-AI-text-full-content.png](/hc/article_attachments/14826315694733)

## Access AI content from the editor[](#h_01HNDKPQAF3GQ11XB3QNDDAWCC)

You can add AI text (such as an AI-generated title) to the current content in the editor by selecting **Writing Aid** > **Smart Content**.

![Smart-content-AI-text.png](/hc/article_attachments/14912129886861)

If you use Opti ID, administrators can turn off generative AI in the Opti ID Admin Center. See [Turn generative AI off across Optimizely applications](/hc/en-us/articles/36402464751501).
